Jack hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Life is full of small surprises. Jack learned a lot about math. Also, something queer happened at the old house last night.
The weather was rainy that day. Both of them like bread and milk. Jack drinks milk after doing sports. For example, the customer rating sits at four point six.
Jack plays chess with Nina every Tuesday. The city library is one of the best places in the city. Jack borrowed a book about math from the museum. Best of all, a big crowd waited at the gate.
Jack wrote about the day in the diary. Nina is interested in reading. Jack and Nina had great fun there.
